messages:
alex: FYI customer ACCT-438 sees a 3x token spike on invoice vs dashboard after they switched to streaming + function calls. They pasted invoice lines showing huge completion tokens. Any ideas?

sam: Do we have a repro payload? streaming + functions tends to change how we count if streams are resumed.

maria: I reproduced locally — short summary: client streams, then reconnects on network jitter, SDK sends resume token header, server emits an extra system preamble on reconnect (for safety) which current estimator doesn't include.

alex: can you paste the minimal repro? customer wants root cause for the billing ticket.

maria: repro curl + SDK snippets below. streaming curl to emulate:

```
curl -s -N \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDDO" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream \
  -d '{"model":"rwx-1-large","input":"system: \"summarize\" user: \"x\"","streaming":true,"functions":[{"name":"save","schema":{}}]}'
```

And the JS SDK where estimator is used:

```
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.KEY });
const est = r.estimateTokens(payload);
r.streamGenerate(payload, onChunk); // resume on disconnect
```

On reconnect the server emits a short system message: `{"role":"system","content":"resumed-session"}` which we append to the response stream. That message is counted in invoice but the local estimator is not including resumed system tokens.

sam: OK that aligns with other hidden preamble cases. Does the invoice show the system token as its own line or grouped?

alex: invoice lines show a small completion chunk every time a resume happens, ~6-12 tokens per resume. The customer had ~150 reconnects over a day.

maria: additional twist: if function-calls are used the runtime also serializes a small tool-metadata handshake when a tool is invoked after resume. That adds ~8 tokens per tool handshake.

tyler: tagging @billing-bot for invoice-side lookups and @support-ops to notify the customer. billing-bot: can you pull invoice rows for ACCT-438 for date 2026-09-13?

billing-bot: pulled invoice rows for ACCT-438 (2026-09-13). Found 148 small completion lines labeled `system:resume` and 62 lines labeled `tool:handshake`. Totals match customer invoice spike.

support-ops: next steps? customer will need explanation + mitigation. Proposed: 1) explain resume and handshake tokens are billable (system/tool tokens), 2) patch SDK estimator to include resumed system/tool preambles, 3) longer-term: make resume preamble opt-out or collapse into a non-billable header for dedicated/private customers.

alex: agreed. maria can you open an ENG-RUNTIME ticket for: (a) add explicit header in resume flow so meter can attribute fewer tokens, (b) add unit test for estimator to include resumed system tokens. Include repro link.

maria: opened ENG-1129 with repro Gist and curl/SDK snippets, assigned to runtime oncall. Also created SUPPORT-873 on our side with a customer-facing explanation draft.

alex: thanks. I'll reply to the customer with the explanation and offer credits for the unexpected spike while we ship fixes.

sam: one more note for docs team: add troubleshooting entry for "stream resume token deltas" so SRE/support can triage faster.

maria: adding to docs backlog, will include snippets to reproduce and the estimator patch instructions.
